'''Ryma Galfrey''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]] who is now a ''[[damane]]''. 

==Appearance==
She is slim and elegant, with dark hair and blue eyes.

==Strength and Abilities==
Ryma is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|weak]] in the [[One Power]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of {{opsl|35}}. This is too weak to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

== History ==
Ryma was born in {{ne|902}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|917}}. After spending eight years as a [[novice]] and seven years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|932}}. 

She is the one to announce to the other Aes Sedai that [[Tamra Ospenya]] had "died in her sleep".

== Activities ==
When the Seanchan landed at [[Falme]], she and [[Sheraine Caminelle]] were captured and made ''damane''. Ryma was renamed '''Pura''' and trained harshly.  When [[Egwene al'Vere]] was collared she met Ryma, who asked her to remember her real name. [[Bayle Domon]] witnessed the capture of Sheraine Caminelle, who screamed for Ryma to help her.{{ref/book|2|43}}

After Falme fell she was taken to [[Cantorin]] where the ''[[sul'dam]]'' [[Taisa]] holds her leash. [[Suroth]] questions her on how the White Tower controls the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Suroth does not believe that Pura does not know.{{ref/book|4|1}} Later she was brought back to the [[Westlands]] after [[Amadicia]] was taken. She is now completely broken.

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Ryma}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Nyokabi Gethaiga}}.
